resources.string: Battery level

What it measures
Remaining charge as a percentage; compare discharge only under similar load.

Scope and units
Entire device battery; %.

Impact
Use the trend to investigate autonomy and battery condition.

Interpretation
Compare the same model, Android version, agent build and configuration. Aggregation: GAUGE.

Example
Compare two equal observation windows under similar load and screen state. A higher value alone does not prove a fault.

Limitations
Unavailable, invalid or stale values are not zero. See the source, reason, observation time and quality beside the value.

Performance State
This metric does not change Performance State automatically. Device battery drain is not agent energy consumption.

Source
device.battery.level. The recorded source identifies Android API, verified sysfs, instrumented operation or calculation.

Scope and units
Entire device storage and I/O; us.

Impact
Use the trend to investigate device-wide I/O pressure, queueing and latency.

Interpretation
Compare the same model, Android version, agent build and configuration. Aggregation: SUM.

Example
Compare two equal observation windows under similar load and screen state. A higher value alone does not prove a fault.
